notes: Cross-verse consistency with JDG.8.1. The same phrase `הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה`, rendered by a single English word in both verses, was fused at v.1 and split at v.3, where `דָּבָר` was marked `unrepresented` under rule 22. Nothing in the source licenses the difference, and rule 22's first sentence governs an element the ASV left unwritten, not a lexical noun whose sense stands inside a fused word. Merged the two units into one fusion headed on the demonstrative, as v.1 heads it.
